items.title: Bill Huntington Interview, 1961-12-27
items.q: Because, uh, I'd get together with him and we'd play vibes. He played, he was playing vibes at the time. And I'd play guitar and, uh, would play standards, you know, things written by Gershwin.

ctx.x: Didn't he care for Baby as musicians? That's what I understand.

I think Bob Matthews told me that Bunk used to call him. Oh, and by the way, Bob Matthews had a lot to do with my development, too, in terms of a transition between modern jazz and traditional jazz. Because, uh, I'd get together with him and we'd play vibes. He played, he was playing vibes at the time. And I'd play guitar and, uh, would play standards, you know, things written by Gershwin. And I'd begin to get used to, uh, listening, listening for that kind of thing, you know, that kind of, uh, impressionistic,…
